_readme: Voice list shown in the web UI's voice picker. voiceId must be one of OpenAI's tts-1 voices: alloy, ash, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer. Preview them at platform.openai.com/docs/guides/text-to-speech. To add/remove options, just edit this array — no code changes needed. If a client picks none, the pipeline falls back to OPENAI_TTS_VOICE (or 'onyx') from .env.local.
